# Unified Architecture — ActiveWorkspace

All three sibling folders share the same `unified/canonical-bundle.js`, `unified/architect-core.js`, storage keys, event contract, and rules version. Generated content is not a loose text artifact: it becomes a versioned registry record with class, path, alignment, era, source references, mechanics, constraints, and a validation report.

Expected parent layout:

```text
AI-Brain/
  ActiveWorkspace/
  Universal_MOL/
  Universal_Player/
```

Sibling links assume that layout.
